records.context: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a microplate sample position can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; a run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its microplate sample positions from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each microplate sample position's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the microplate sample positions run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``.
records.label: spacr.ops_engine.run_ops#4
records.source: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a well can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; a run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its wells from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each well's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the wells run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``.
records.translation: hvaða af ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` og ``"decode"`` sem er, keyrt í þeirri röð. Fasi sem er sleppt les það sem hann þarf úr gagnagrunninum, svo hægt er að skeyta brunn saman einu sinni og afkóða hann aftur. Alfa-svipgerðarleiðin bætir við ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` og ``"aggregate"``, sem eru aðeins keyrð þegar þau eru nefnd hér og þá á eftir þessum fjórum; keyrsla með aðeins þessum þarf ``dst_root`` og ``plate`` en ekkert ``genotype_source``, tekur brunna sína úr ``ops_phenotype`` og bætir við ``ops_report.json`` hvers brunns í stað þess að skipta henni út. ``aggregate`` safnar saman keyrðu brunnunum og skrifar ``ops_guides_<plate>`` og ``ops_genes_<plate>``.
